# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> No. 29 Brentwood Crescent, Earlscourt, Dunmore Road, Waterford, X91 NWP3. DNG Reid & Coppinger are delighted to present No. 29 Brentwood Crescent to the market. This substantial four/five-bedroom semi-detached dormer-style residence extends to approximately c. 135 Sqm. / c.1,453 sq.ft.
